q1_issues.issue: The possessive in "its star" is not encoded anywhere — no Possession or PartOf links sk_star_1 to sk_planet_1, either inside the seal or at top level, so the star's connection to the planet is lost.
(Ongoing sk_form_2) is emitted for "was ... just in the process of forming", which is not one of the four explicit Ongoing markers the instruction set enumerates.

q2_gaps: periphrastic progressive "be in the process of V-ing" — Status predicates fixes exactly four Ongoing markers (progressive morphology, continuative perfect, inceptive complement, perception participle) and this is none of them
numeric scale words ("12.713 billion years") — Measures & units gives no rule for expanding billion/million into the magnitude slot, nor for keeping the scale word

a "with"-phrase naming an INANIMATE co-participant ("the planet formed with its star") — the stated split is CoAgent (animate) vs Instrument (the means), and neither fits, leaving the case to the preposition-named oblique only by default
notes: The non-factive seal is handled correctly — nothing about the planet's formation is asserted at top level, and only the definite referents' typing atoms project. BeforeBy against the reserved now, and During for the "when"-clause, both match the Time section.
